# LDS Theme

LK brand, color, typography, elevation, gradient, and motion decisions.

## AI and migration start here

Before changing a UI or converting an existing application to LDS:

1. Read `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/llms.txt`.
2. Read every applicable facet in the generated, read-only `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/adoption-checklist.json`.
3. Copy `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/docs/adoption-report.example.json` to `.lds/adoption-report.json` and `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/docs/adoption-report.schema.json` to `.lds/adoption-report.schema.json` together, preserving the report's relative `$schema` link; never edit generated package files.
4. Replace every placeholder with real outcomes and evidence, keep the copied schema pinned and read-only, then run the adoption conformance command described by the workflow.
5. Record `reviewed`, `not-applicable`, or `blocked` with concrete evidence; component mapping alone is not completion.

The complete 16-Foundation context is available from the installed `@lk-design-system/lds-core` dependency.

## Runtime entry points

- JavaScript and types: `@lk-design-system/lds-theme`
- Styles: `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/styles.css`
- Machine-readable documentation index: `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/design-system.json`
- Full packaged documentation: `@lk-design-system/lds-theme/docs/*`

Import owner styles in dependency order: Core, Theme, Product, then Robotics when used.
